name: Chikan Shoudou
source:
One day, Akira sees a girl at train station. She looks like an ordinary girl at first sight. But, he is attracted to her fragile air. He gets on a train, and thinks, "She won't resist if someone secretly molests her on a train...." As a day goes on, he gets more strongly attracted to her. And finally, he can't stop his sexual desire to molest her....
